name: claude-migrate-memory-to-doc
description: >- Migrates Claude Code personal memory (the per-project memory/ directory) into tool-agnostic reference docs so other AI CLIs that auto-load AGENTS.md (Codex primarily) can read the same user profile and preferences. Use when the user says "migrate my memory", "my memory is locked to Claude Code", "make Codex/Cursor read my profile", or reports memory has grown bloated with content that should be shared across tools.
author: daymade
